# Playwright E2E

- Prefer role/label/text-based locators.
- Avoid brittle CSS/XPath selectors.
- Wait for observable application states, not arbitrary sleeps.
- Isolate test data.
- Keep authentication setup reusable.
- Capture traces/screenshots for failures when useful.
- Test critical workflows across realistic viewport sizes.
